summary: Writes CHOP input data to a local or global shared-memory segment for Shared Mem In CHOP in the same or another process.
key_concepts: Shared Mem Out CHOP sends CHOP data to a shared-memory segment read by Shared Mem In CHOP.
The operator is available only in TouchDesigner Educational, Commercial, and Pro licenses.
The official page separately notes Shared Mem Out TOP has Commercial/Pro availability, so CHOP and TOP licensing should not be assumed identical.
Active controls whether the CHOP cooks its inputs and writes to the memory block.
Shared Mem Type selects Local mode for a name-unique shared segment or Global mode for the combined shared-memory segment.
Shared-memory output is local IPC; use Pipe Out CHOP when pipe/channel transport semantics fit better.

key_params.name: active
key_params.note: Cook inputs and write to the memory block

key_params.name: local
key_params.note: Use a shared-memory segment unique for the given name

key_params.name: global
key_params.note: Use the combined global shared-memory segment

key_params.name: autoexportroot
key_params.note: Root path for automatic channel-name exports

key_params.name: exporttable
key_params.note: DAT table used by DAT table export methods

common_gotchas: Official docs list Shared Mem Out CHOP as available only in Educational, Commercial, and Pro licenses.
The official page also notes Shared Mem Out TOP has stricter Commercial/Pro availability; do not infer CHOP and TOP licensing are identical.
Local mode is required when sharing with non-TouchDesigner applications.
Global mode shares through a combined segment; avoid accidental name collisions.
Shared-memory workflows are local-machine/process IPC, not network transport.
Use Pipe Out CHOP or Touch Out CHOP when process or network semantics are a better match.
The receiving Shared Mem In CHOP must use the matching name and compatible memory type.
